l4_steps.name: Extract channel cost data from PSS and finance
l4_steps.input: Monthly GDS booking fee invoices from Sabre, Travelport, Amadeus; Altéa PSS transaction logs
l4_steps.output: Channel cost report segmented by GDS, NDC, and direct booking source
l4_steps.kpi: Cost extraction completeness ≥99% of bookings reconciled per period
l4_steps.pain_point: Sabre, Travelport, and Amadeus each use different invoice formats and fee codes; reconciliation against Altéa PSS PNRs requires manual mapping that introduces errors in ~2–3% of bookings

l4_steps.name: Allocate GDS booking fees to route and O&D level
l4_steps.input: Channel cost report, Altéa PSS O&D booking data
l4_steps.output: Per-segment distribution cost dataset by route, O&D, and booking class
l4_steps.kpi: GDS cost per booking reconciled within ±$0.05 vs. invoiced totals
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa PSS booking records must be joined to SAP cost data at different granularities; PNR format mismatches between GDS sources and PSS cause join failures requiring manual resolution

l4_steps.name: Validate and approve cost allocation baseline
l4_steps.input: Per-segment distribution cost dataset from AWS Redshift
l4_steps.output: Approved distribution cost baseline dashboard with channel-level unit economics
l4_steps.kpi: Baseline approved and published within 5 business days of period close
l4_steps.pain_point: Disputed cost allocations between Finance and Commercial teams delay sign-off; no single P&L owner for distribution costs creates accountability gaps that slow the optimization cycle

l4_steps.name: Benchmark distribution cost vs. industry peers
l4_steps.input: Approved cost baseline, IATA Distribution Cost Study, OAG channel share data
l4_steps.output: Competitive gap analysis: cost per booking vs. peer carriers by channel
l4_steps.kpi: Distribution cost per booking target ≤$11.00 (vs. IATA industry average of $14–18)
l4_steps.pain_point: Industry peer benchmarks are self-reported and often exclude hidden indirect costs such as agency incentive overrides; benchmarking accuracy is limited and results may misstate true competitive position

l4_steps.name: Set channel-specific cost reduction targets
l4_steps.input: Competitive gap analysis, annual revenue and margin plan
l4_steps.output: Approved cost reduction targets by channel (GDS, NDC, direct) for the planning year
l4_steps.kpi: Target: 15% reduction in blended distribution cost per booking year-on-year
l4_steps.pain_point: Commercial teams may resist aggressive NDC shift targets when GDS volume is contractually linked to incentive tiers or corporate travel agreements that cannot be restructured mid-year

l4_steps.name: Identify high-cost booking segments and routes
l4_steps.input: Cost baseline, channel mix data from Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.output: Priority route and channel matrix: top 20% routes by distribution cost contributing ≥40% of GDS spend
l4_steps.kpi: Top-20% high-cost routes identified and validated within 3 business days of baseline approval
l4_steps.pain_point: High-yield corporate routes are typically the highest GDS-cost segments; reducing GDS dependency on these routes risks losing managed travel bookings routed through Sabre PRISM by TMC partners

l4_steps.name: Assess NDC API capability and agency readiness
l4_steps.input: NDC adoption tracker, agency certification status list, OBT compatibility matrix
l4_steps.output: Agency NDC readiness scorecard ranked by booking volume
l4_steps.kpi: ≥60% of top-50 agencies NDC-certified within 6 months of programme launch
l4_steps.pain_point: Mid-market agencies lack NDC-capable booking tools; OBTs such as SAP Concur require separate NDC plug-ins with additional integration fees, creating adoption friction outside the top-10 agency pool

l4_steps.name: Design NDC incentive and GDS surcharge structure
l4_steps.input: Agency NDC readiness scorecard, current commission and override schedule
l4_steps.output: NDC incentive tier schedule and GDS surcharge policy filed via ATPCO
l4_steps.kpi: NDC incentive cost per shifted booking ≤50% of the GDS fee saving on the same booking
l4_steps.pain_point: ATPCO filing of channel-differentiated pricing is restricted by fare parity clauses in certain GDS full-content agreements and by regulatory price-parity rules in EU and select APAC markets; legal review adds 4–6 weeks per market

l4_steps.name: Negotiate NDC adoption agreements with top agencies
l4_steps.input: NDC incentive tier schedule, agency booking volume data from Sabre PRISM
l4_steps.output: Signed NDC adoption agreements covering milestone targets and incentive conditions
l4_steps.kpi: NDC adoption agreements signed with agencies covering ≥40% of total indirect booking volume
l4_steps.pain_point: Large TMCs (BCD Travel, CWT, Amex GBT) negotiate distribution terms as blocs; failure to reach agreement risks losing the entire managed travel segment, which may represent 25–35% of revenue on key business routes

l4_steps.name: Activate NDC channel and monitor booking shift
l4_steps.input: Signed adoption agreements, NDC API go-live checklist, Amadeus Altéa PSS integration confirmation
l4_steps.output: NDC booking volume report; channel shift metrics vs. GDS baseline
l4_steps.kpi: NDC share of indirect bookings ≥20% within 12 months of channel activation
l4_steps.pain_point: NDC API stability issues — including rate limit breaches, error code ambiguity, and mid-session session token failures — cause booking failures that agents attribute to the airline, risking channel abandonment and reversion to GDS

l4_steps.name: Audit GDS full-content agreement compliance
l4_steps.input: GDS full-content contracts (Sabre, Travelport, Amadeus), booking volume reports from Altéa PSS
l4_steps.output: Full-content compliance audit report by GDS and market
l4_steps.kpi: GDS contract compliance rate ≥98%; zero penalty clauses triggered
l4_steps.pain_point: GDS full-content clauses require all published fares to be available in GDS, creating direct tension with NDC-exclusive offer strategies; legal interpretation of content parity varies by GDS provider and jurisdiction, increasing compliance risk

l4_steps.name: Renegotiate GDS booking fee and incentive terms
l4_steps.input: Full-content compliance audit, multi-year volume forecast, peer airline benchmark data
l4_steps.output: Renegotiated GDS agreement with revised booking fee tiers and volume-based incentive schedule
l4_steps.kpi: GDS booking fee reduction ≥10% vs. current contracted rate across all three GDS providers
l4_steps.pain_point: Sabre, Travelport, and Amadeus maintain strong negotiating leverage; airlines with less than 5% regional GDS market share have limited bargaining power, and fee concessions often require multi-year volume commitments that constrain future NDC migration

l4_steps.name: Restructure agency override commission schedule
l4_steps.input: Renegotiated GDS terms, agency performance data from Sabre PRISM
l4_steps.output: Updated performance-linked agency incentive schedule with NDC migration milestones
l4_steps.kpi: Agency incentive cost as % of total revenue ≤2.5% (down from industry average ~3.5%)
l4_steps.pain_point: Legacy override commission structures in Sabre PRISM are deeply embedded in agency workflows; unilateral reductions risk booking withdrawal by top-producing agencies during the renegotiation window, creating a short-term revenue gap

l4_steps.name: Track blended distribution cost per booking weekly
l4_steps.input: Weekly GDS fee invoices from Sabre, Travelport, Amadeus; NDC booking data; direct booking revenue data from Altéa PSS
l4_steps.output: Weekly distribution cost dashboard with channel-level unit cost and trend vs. target
l4_steps.kpi: Blended distribution cost per booking ≤$11.50; dashboard published within T+2 business days of week close
l4_steps.pain_point: Weekly GDS invoice data from Sabre, Travelport, and Amadeus arrives on different billing cycles (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly), creating inconsistent data availability and lag in blended cost visibility

l4_steps.name: Identify cost leakage and wrong-channel bookings
l4_steps.input: Weekly distribution cost dashboard, PNR source data from Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.output: Cost leakage report: high-cost outlier bookings, NDC-enrolled agencies still booking via GDS
l4_steps.kpi: Cost leakage identified and escalated within 5 business days; leakage <2% of total distribution cost
l4_steps.pain_point: Wrong-channel bookings — NDC-enrolled agencies reverting to GDS — are difficult to detect without real-time PNR source tracking; Altéa PSS booking source flags are inconsistently populated by some GDS-connected OBTs

l4_steps.name: Report cost performance to leadership and plan next cycle
l4_steps.input: Cost leakage report, monthly blended distribution cost summary, YoY trend data
l4_steps.output: Executive distribution cost report; updated channel optimization action plan for next quarter
l4_steps.kpi: Monthly report delivered within 5 business days of period close; YoY cost reduction trajectory on track vs. 15% annual target
l4_steps.pain_point: Executive reporting requires attribution of cost changes to specific initiatives (NDC shift, GDS renegotiation, incentive restructure), but the multi-year lag in GDS contract cycles and NDC adoption curves makes causal attribution difficult without a controlled test-and-learn design
